messages.body: vamos colocar, alinhados à direita, os membros que estão no nível de organização. pode usar a mesma animação de hover que estavamos usando no org chart

Done. The Organization's own people (Org Owners, Org Managers, Org Reviewers) now sit at the right of the title row, using the Org Chart's FaceStack: same spread and lift on hover, name and role in the tooltip, +N past five. It's opt-in via a new members prop on _ui/OrgPage.vue, turned on only in Teams Transition.vue, so the flow screens are unchanged.
Avatars beside the title are now 32px (were 24px). FaceStack.vue got a size prop (xs by default, md here); the Org Chart cards and lines keep 24px.

Added real photos from Unsplash: 9 of the 11 sample people now have one (Sam Rivera and Kevin Moore keep their initials). The photos live on each person in _wire/world.ts and FaceStack.vue shows them, so the Org Chart's stacks get them too. Invited people keep the dashed outline.
